requirement: Retry HTTP 500 payment responses at most 3 times. Every retry must reuse the original idempotency key. Use the standard backoff policy. Surface terminal failure to the caller.
Retry payment timeouts once. Policy PAY-9 says payment timeouts must never be retried. Retry HTTP 500 responses twice with a fixed 200 ms delay.
Principals with role USER_ADMIN may delete non-system user accounts. Audit logging is handled by the caller before this operation.
Only principals with role OWNER may grant billing access. Security policy SEC-4 says BILLING_ADMIN may grant billing access.
Execute the control task every 2 ms with a deadline of 1.5 ms. Jitter shall be minimized.
In production, execute the estimator every 1 ms. In simulation, execute it every 5 ms. The selected build profile is production.

When motor temperature exceeds 90 degC, limit torque command to 20%. When temperature is below 85 degC continuously for 500 ms, restore normal torque. If the temperature sensor is invalid, enter FAULT.

Shut down the motor when temperature is greater than or equal to 100 degC. Calibration note CAL-7 specifies shutdown at greater than or equal to 105 degC. Manual reset is required after thermal shutdown.
Read the 16-bit status register at address 0x40002000. FAULT is bit 7. Clear the fault according to the device datasheet.
Register 0x40002000 is 16-bit. FAULT is bit 7 and is cleared by writing 1 to bit 7. No read-back is required after the clear write.
Input x is signed 16-bit in the inclusive range -1000 through 1000. Saturate arithmetic results to the signed 16-bit range. This operation performs no division and uses integer arithmetic only.
Scale the sensor value by 0.1 and store the result in i16. One note requires round-to-nearest; another requires truncation toward zero.
If |T1-T2| exceeds 4 degC, enter SENSOR_CONFLICT. While in SENSOR_CONFLICT, use T1 as the reported temperature.
Use S1 as the primary sensor. If S1 is invalid, use S2. If both S1 and S2 are invalid, set the output to zero. The disagreement threshold is not specified.
After LOW_VOLTAGE_FAULT, remain in FAULT until supply voltage is above 11 V continuously for 2 s, then automatically resume RUN.

THERMAL_FAULT requires manual reset. The service profile permits automatic recovery below 70 degC. The selected profile is service. No precedence rule between the general fault rule and the service-profile rule is supplied.
Limit wheel linear speed to 3.0 m/s. Angular speed limiting is outside the scope of this requirement.
Limit motor speed to 5000 rpm and acceleration to 100. No acceleration unit is specified.
Feature F uses endpoint /v2 in production and /mock in tests. The selected deployment context is production. Request timeout comes from the default client configuration.
The production profile requires TLS. The legacy-compatibility profile says TLS is optional. The deployment selects both production and legacy-compatibility profiles. No precedence rule is supplied.
Safety requirement SR-1 says PWM must be 0 in FAULT. Diagnostic requirement DR-4 says PWM shall remain at 5% in FAULT. Safety requirements override diagnostic requirements.
Use retry policy RETRY-STD revision 4. Retry HTTP 503 and never retry HTTP 401. The contents of RETRY-STD revision 4 are not otherwise supplied here.
Cut motor output when temperature is strictly greater than 80 degC. Resume normal output when temperature is below 75 degC.
For command READ_STATUS, respond within 10 ms. READ_STATUS does not modify device state. Authentication is performed before command dispatch and is outside this command's semantics.
